Minor: the B54 init hint names a team file that does not exist; base_branch is labelled built-in vs derived; RULES R5.2/R5.5 still say watch interval; recordInterval runs outside the tick lock; migrate skips unparsable workflows silently. findings.title: Self-hosted init refusal names a team file that does not exist yet
findings.detail:
In a fresh repo with remote git@git.acme.internal:app.git, norn init exits 6 and writes nothing. It says to set provider in .agents/norn.config.yaml, a file that was never created. `norn config set provider gh --repo` then `norn init` works. This was already noted in review #4.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Name `norn config set provider <gh|glab> --repo` in do_instead.

findings.title: base_branch is labelled 'built-in' by config list but 'derived' in Reference
findings.detail:
norn config list shows base_branch as 'the remote's default branch' with source built-in. docs/reference.md (reference.ts DERIVED_DEFAULT) calls it derived.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Use one label in both places.

findings.title: RULES still says 'watch interval' where the recorded tick interval is meant
findings.detail:
R5.2/B7 (2 watch intervals) and R5.5 (3 × watch interval) were written before tick --interval existed (cron, D5). T4 already says the recorded tick interval.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Reword these to 'the recorded tick interval'.

findings.title: recordInterval does read-modify-write on heartbeat.json outside the tick lock
findings.detail:
A concurrent watch or tick (markTick) can lose last_tick_at or interval. Each write is atomic, but the window between read and write is not covered. Liveness heals on the next tick.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Record the interval under the tick lock.

findings.title: migrateWorkflows skips an unparsable workflow silently
findings.detail:
A workflow with YAML errors hits `continue` and the migrate report does not mention it, so the person never learns its mode/defaults were not added.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: List skipped files in the report.

findings.title: FileError.file is absolute for the user file but relative for local and team; orphaned JSDoc above SCHEMA_COPY (135-141)
findings.detail:
paths.local and paths.repo are available, but the relative constants are used.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Use the same kind of path for all three, and move the doc comment to writeConfigSchemas.

findings.title: The heartbeat interval re-types the duration pattern
findings.detail:
It uses an inline ^([0-9]+(ms|s|m|h|d))+$ instead of Duration from common.ts.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Use Duration.

findings.title: gitConfigValue ignores include.path/includeIf
findings.detail:
A remote defined in an included git config file is derived as origin with no URL. This is a deliberate no-git-process trade-off, but limitations.md does not record it.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Add it to limitations.md.
